summary: Full verification of is-agentic.com agent-readiness fixes for auremcto.com. All curl-level and browser-level checks PASS. /developers renders SSR H1 in raw HTML and hydrates cleanly in browser with data-testid='developers-page'. 404 middleware correctly returns real 404 with links (sitemap.xml, llms.txt, developers, api/docs). All 10 pre-existing routes still return 200 (no regression from KNOWN_PREFIXES change). All 3 /.well-known/* files return 200 with valid JSON — the shadowing-by-404-middleware bug is confirmed fixed. OpenAPI has BearerAuth security scheme (type=http, scheme=bearer, description mentions read:repo/write:repo/ship:commit/admin scopes) and top-level security=[{BearerAuth:[]}]. Both legacy x-ratelimit-* and IETF standard ratelimit-* headers present on /api/openapi.json. Homepage footer has all 5 new testids (footer-developers, footer-api-docs, footer-openapi, footer-llms-txt, footer-about) with correct hrefs. llms.txt updated with Developer portal, well-known links, and honest 'no separate OAuth 2.0 client-credentials AS' disclaimer. The 'LOADING…' screenshot quirk main agent saw did NOT reproduce here — page renders normally; likely was a transient headless-browser hydration artifact, not a real user-facing bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie-consent banner covers the bottom-right of /developers on desktop until dismissed — not blocking (footer links still clickable), but consider not showing on utility/dev pages, or ensure it doesn't overlap the llms-full.txt link on smaller viewports.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) are logged on every page load; consider opting-in to silence noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All agent-readiness fixes verified against live preview pod (yarn start / Vite dev server, same as prod deploy). No regressions. Screenshot 'LOADING' quirk from main agent was not reproducible — /developers hydrates fine after networkidle+2s wait.
